notes.title: v2 Update: Pedestrian System, Visual Upgrade & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Car Parking Real Driving Sim v2 update offers a much more lively, much smoother city experience. Thanks to the improvements made according to the player feedback, both driving and parking are now much more enjoyable.

v2 Update Notes
[list]
[*] Pedestrian NPC System added: City streets are no longer empty! The environment is more lively and realistic thanks to pedestrian characters.
[*] Graphics quality has been increased and the game has been optimized: Lighting, texture quality and general performance have been improved. A smoother experience has been provided on all devices.
[*] Camera bugs have been fixed and the camera system has been improved: In-car and out-of-car camera transitions are smoother, position errors have been eliminated. Better control has been provided while driving.
[*] Bugs have been fixed in line with general user feedback: Mission triggers, UI behaviors, minor visual bugs and control issues have been fixed.
[*] UI adjustments have been made: Mission panels, settings and information screens are now much more readable and intuitive.
[/list]
